provenance.scope: software preparation only; no real activation arrays or scientific study fit

limitation: Preparation utilities only: no study activation bank or model is loaded. Fit guards rely on explicitly supplied training rows and identifiers. Alignment and ridge parameters are fixed before heldout transformation. Reduced-rank ridge requires one fixed complete target matrix; missing-label or per-output masked reduced-rank regression is not implemented. Synthetic selfchecks do not constitute a new scientific result.
